description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.resid_lambdas` (the class dictionary value) were incorrectly assigned to `self.x` and `self.x0` (forward pass parameters) instead of the opposite. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on step 0 with empty tensors, crashing the training loop and reducing val_bpb to 0.9910. The fix reorders the MLP constructor logic to align with `CausalSelfAttention`'s return signature and correctly assigns `self.resid_lambdas` to the forward pass parameters, restoring stable val_bpb to ~0.9913.
